premise: A night-shift security guard faces an evacuation line that turns on anyone who joins it.
A choice glimpsed through a fatal branch sends the guard and another survivor down the unlit railway path.
Escaping the line reveals that the danger can already be waiting outside it.

characters.visualDNA: Adult Indonesian woman, night-shift security guard, short black hair under a dark cap, dark straight-hem rain jacket over a security uniform, dark trousers and PDL boots.
